messages:
alejandra: quick design check — attaching the updated canary snapshot card. I moved timestamp under commit message for visual cleanliness. wondering about screen reader flow. thoughts? Tariq: looks cleaner visually. concern: SR users might hear timestamp too late. maybe keep message -> sha -> author -> timestamp for context. :thinking_face: sam: agree with Tariq. also the rollback CTA currently reads 'Revert to this version' — long on narrow screens. marta: suggest shorter primary CTA: 'Rollback' and secondary 'Preview'. Add aria-describedby to rollback explaining intent. alejandra: updated microcopy proposal: button -> `Rollback`; sr-only string -> 'Creates a new deployment pinned to this version.' Reordering for SR: commit message, short sha, author, timestamp. kevin: +1. For keyboard users, make each snapshot card a single focusable region with internal roving tabindex for actions. Current three separate focusables are noisy. Tariq: also add an aria-live="polite" region for canary promotion progress and announcements for failed auto-promotions. a11y-bot: note: if you change DOM order to help SR, preserve visual order with CSS `order` rather than moving content off-screen. Avoid display:none for SR-only content. alejandra: will keep DOM in SR-friendly order and use flex-order for visuals. Won't hide content with display:none. sam: another nit — version history timeline collapse handle is tiny (6px). increase to 24px hit target and left-align label so keyboard focus is more predictable. marta: adding a11y checklist for the PR: focus order, aria-live, rollback aria-describedby, 24px hit targets, keyboard-only hover states, SR smoke-test. kevin: add an e2e: tab to snapshot card, Enter Rollback, expect modal 'Confirm rollback' with visible focus trap. screenshot assertions. alejandra: I'll update Figma and push annotated interactions. tagging @sam @tariq for final copy/QA by EOD. :thumbsup: sam: will review copy. Tariq: I'll run SR pass tomorrow morning and report results. marta: I'll add the a11y items to the PR template so it's not missed. kevin: small but important. alejandra: follow-up code snippet idea for aria-describedby: aria-describedby=\"rollback-intent-\" with nearby sr-only div:
\" class=\"sr-only\">Creates a new deployment pinned to commit by on .
Tariq: perfect, provides context for announcements. marta: merging checklist: design signoff, a11y smoke-pass, keyboard test, e2e modal focus test. alejandra: thanks all — will post Figma link + final copy once updated. :sparkles:
